headline.purpose: Major section titles; the name on home, set in serif italic.

lead.purpose: Opening intent statement under a name or section.

serif-accent.purpose: Newsreader italic: names, subtitles, section headings, pull quotes.

mono.purpose: IBM Plex Mono: inline code only.

shadows.name: card-shadow
shadows.purpose: The only sanctioned elevation: a hairline ring plus a whisper-soft lift. Dark mode swaps tints to rgba(255,255,255,0.06)/0.04.

shadows.name: image-outline
shadows.purpose: Crisp 1px inset outline on images so they read as specimens, not floating objects.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Default curve for entrances and state shifts, 0.4-0.5s. Section content fades up from y:16, staggered ~0.1s.

motion.name: ease-wordmark
motion.purpose: 420ms curve for the R-S wordmark letter-spacing/width expansion on hover.

components.name: Accent Link
components.description: Outbound/primary inline link in Hot Coral with a trailing arrow; underline on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-link-accent { color: #ff4552; font-family: 'OpenRunde', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25em; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, text-decoration-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-link-accent:hover, .ds-link-accent:focus-visible { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; opacity: 0.8; outline: none; }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Project preview: 16:9 cover that scales on hover, title that shifts to Hot Coral, serif-italic subtitle, muted body.
components.html:
White-label eSIMYesim

A working prototype for a B2B customization flow, built on the production tech stack.
components.css: .ds-work-card { display: block; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'OpenRunde', system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 420px; } .ds-work-card__media { overflow: hidden; } .ds-work-card__img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0f0f0, #e8e8e8); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-work-card:hover .ds-work-card__img { transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-work-card__body { padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-work-card__head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-work-card__title { color: #0a0a0a; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.3; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-work-card:hover .ds-work-card__title { color: #ff4552; } .ds-work-card__sub { color: #6b6b6b; font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-work-card__desc { color: #6b6b6b; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: 32px transparent round icon button holding a 16px contrast icon; presses with a slight scale-down.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Switch theme"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 22A10 10 0 1112 2v20zm0-2V4a8 8 0 000 16z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; width: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #0a0a0a; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { background: #f0f0f0; } .ds-theme-toggle:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #a0a0a0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: R-S Wordmark
components.description: Home logo; on hover the center em-dash widens and letter-spacing opens. The one piece of pure delight.
components.html: R—S
components.css: .ds-wordmark { text-decoration: none; color: #0a0a0a; -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none; } .ds-wordmark__inner { display: inline-block; font-family: 'OpenRunde', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: normal; transition: letter-spacing 420ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-wordmark:hover .ds-wordmark__inner, .ds-wordmark:focus-visible .ds-wordmark__inner { letter-spacing: 0.12em; outline: none; } .ds-wordmark__dash { display: inline-block; width: 1em; text-align: center; transition: width 420ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-wordmark:hover .ds-wordmark__dash, .ds-wordmark:focus-visible .ds-wordmark__dash { width: 1.8em; }

components.name: Pull Quote
components.description: Editorial callout: Hot Coral quote mark over serif-italic body. The single sanctioned vertical accent rule in the system.
components.css: .ds-pullquote { border-left: 3px solid #ff4552; padding: 4px 0 4px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0; } .ds-pullquote__mark { color: #ff4552; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-pullquote__body { font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; color: rgba(10,10,10,0.9); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }

components.name: Pulsing Availability Dot
components.description: Success-green dot with an expanding ring, preceding the 'open to roles' line. Stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
components.html: Open to product designer roles, full-time
components.css: .ds-availability { font-family: 'OpenRunde', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #6b6b6b; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; } .ds-availability__dot { display: inline-block; width: 0.375em; height: 0.375em; margin-right: 0.6em; border-radius: 9999px; background: #16a34a; vertical-align: 0.12em; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 #16a34a; animation: ds-pulse 3s infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(22,163,74,0.55); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.41em rgba(22,163,74,0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(22,163,74,0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-availability__dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Dashed Divider
components.description: Full-width 1px dashed rule at Ink Muted/30%. The default between-section separator.
components.css: .ds-divider { width: 100%; height: 0; border: none; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(107,107,107,0.3); margin: 0; }

components.name: Inline Code
components.description: Mono inline code on a quiet secondary fill.
components.css: .ds-code-line { font-family: 'OpenRunde', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-code { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875em; background: #f0f0f0; color: #0a0a0a; border-radius: 5px; padding: 0.2em 0.4em; }

narrative.overview: This is a designer-who-codes spec sheet, not a marketing site. The page behaves like a well-set type specimen with evidence in the margins: claims arrive next to the number, the artifact, or the working prototype that proves them. Restraint is the whole posture. A near-monochrome grayscale carries almost the entire surface so that the one hot-coral accent reads as a deliberate annotation, never decoration. Density is generous and reading-first, in a single ~700px column with fluid type and varied vertical rhythm. Depth is flat by default: hairline rings and 1px image outlines define edges instead of drop shadows. Motion is quiet and consistent, a single ease-out curve applied to fades and small state shifts.
keyCharacteristics: Near-monochrome neutrals; one hot-coral signal used on ≤10% of any screen.
Type-led hierarchy: rounded geometric sans for everything, serif italic for names and asides, mono for code.
Flat by default, defined by hairlines and 1px outlines, not shadows.
Single-column ~700px reading measure with fluid type and varied spacing.
One ease-out motion curve; restrained, feedback-only animation.
Dual light/dark theme, system-aware, user-toggleable, persisted.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Hot Coral appears on no more than ~10% of any screen and marks exactly one kind of thing at a time (a link, an active state, a quote). If two unrelated elements both fight for it, neither gets it.

rules.name: The Clean Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals stay near-true grayscale; do not tint them toward the accent. Keep the field off-pure (#fafafa / #111111), never #ffffff or #000000 on the page background.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: OpenRunde ships in 400 and 500 only. Hierarchy comes from scale, color, and the serif/sans contrast, not from a ladder of weights.

rules.name: The Serif-for-Human Rule
rules.body: Newsreader italic is reserved for human and editorial register (names, asides, quotes). It never sets functional UI or running body copy.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Edges are defined by 1px borders, 1px image outlines, and tonal surface steps. Reach for a hairline or the next tonal tier before reaching for a shadow.

rules.name: The Ease-Out Rule
rules.body: Entrance and state motion uses one curve, cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), at 0.4-0.5s. No bounce, no elastic, no spring overshoot.

dos: Do keep Hot Coral (#ff4552) to ≤10% of any screen, marking one kind of thing at a time.
Do build hierarchy from scale + the serif/sans contrast, using only OpenRunde 400 and 500.
Do define edges with hairlines (1px borders, 1px image outlines) and tonal surface steps before reaching for any shadow.
Do hold running text to the ~700px measure (≈65-75ch) and vary vertical rhythm for pacing.
Do animate with the single ease-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), 0.4-0.5s) and gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep the field off-pure: #fafafa / #111111, never #ffffff or #000000 as the page background.
Do reserve Newsreader italic for names, asides, and quotes; reserve IBM Plex Mono for code.
donts: Don't build a loud SaaS landing: no gradient heroes, animated metric counters, glowing or large filled CTAs, or feature-grid cards.
Don't ship the generic portfolio template look: Framer/Webflow defaults, identical same-size project cards, 'passionate creative' framing.
Don't make a Dribbble showpiece: no decorative mockups floating on gradients; every visual ties to a real problem and outcome.
Don't over-animate: no scroll-jacking, parallax, spring/bounce, or motion that performs instead of serving comprehension.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, list items, or alerts. The Pull Quote is the only exception in this system.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text), decorative glassmorphism/blur, or the big-number hero-metric template.
Don't tint the neutrals toward coral, or add a second accent color. One voice only.
Don't introduce drop shadows to dramatize surfaces; if it looks like a 2014 card stack, the shadow is wrong for this system.
